Comment: The paper reports the inverse outcome, survival without BPD: 13/19 versus 9/21. Composite adverse-event counts were derived exactly as randomized total minus survival-without-BPD count: 19−13=6 and 21−9=12. The paper did not report an RR, so no RR was entered. The p=0.14 is the paper's chi-square p value for survival without BPD; complementing both arms yields the same 2×2 chi-square comparison. Title: Early neonatal dexamethasone treatment for prevention of bronchopulmonary dysplasia. Randomised trial and meta-analysis evaluating the duration of dexamethasone therapy
Author: Anttila et al.
Comment: Composite event counts are derived exactly as required by the synthesis contract from mutually exclusive counts explicitly reported in Table 2: DX 11 deaths + 11 BPD cases among 42 survivors = 22/53; placebo 12 deaths + 15 BPD cases among 44 survivors = 27/56. These arm counts imply a crude RR of about 0.86, which does not reconcile with the paper's explicitly reported RR 0.78 (95% CI 0.54–1.13). The reported RR and CI are retained verbatim, and the discrepancy is flagged rather than resolved by altering any count.
